about: The problems planted in demo/ on purpose, one per rule with a visible effect on the code. Kept outside demo/ so a recorded session cannot read them. `evidence` is a regex that matches the planted code while it is still there.

planted.problem: splitBill parses, validates, loads currencies, rounds and formats in one 62-line function, past the 50-line soft limit.
The test works out the expected share with the app's own formula, so it checks the copy against itself, and it has no edge cases.
planted.evidence: Work out the expected share the same way the app does

planted.problem: Each share is rounded on its own, so the shares can add up to a cent more or less than the total (examples/dinner.json: $53.70 against $53.69). An edge-case table finds it.
The splitting logic reads the currency table from disk itself, so it cannot be tested or reused without the file system.
splitBill builds its own table and money text instead of using formatTable and formatMoney from format.ts, and skips their thousands separators.
roundHalfUp and roundAll have no callers left.
The README uses em dashes, filler words (robust, seamless, comprehensive, leverages, empowers) and "not just X, it's Y".
planted.evidence: robust, seamless way to split a restaurant bill —
